title: 12-Layer Dual-Band AR with Tightened Perturbation Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Halving the thickness perturbation range from ±150 nm to ±75 nm will enable finer local gradient descent around the previous best configuration (target_score 0.9828), potentially recovering the remaining 0.0172 headroom without escaping to already-tested stack fingerprints.
design_principle: Local refinement of multilayer thicknesses using transfer matrix method with reduced search space to converge on local optima near the previous best candidate.
proposed_topology: 12 finite layers alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 starting with Ta2O5 at air interface, terminating into semi-infinite silicon substrate
design_variables: perturbation initialization ±75 nm around previous best
soft_objectives: minimize mean reflectance across 1260-1360 nm band
minimize mean reflectance across 1530-1565 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm
materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference optimization
Local gradient descent benefits from reduced perturbation bounds near known optima
expected_advantages: Finer thickness resolution may capture local minima missed by broader search
Avoids re-exploring already-tested stack fingerprints from previous iteration
Maintains proven 12-layer topology with demonstrated 0.9828 baseline
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum without improvement if previous configuration was already at local minimum
execution_request_english: Optimize a 12-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 anti-reflection coating on silicon substrate for dual-band operation. Layer sequence: Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2 (12 finite layers). Air incidence at 0 degrees, unpolarized light. Wavelength bands: 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm. Initialize thickness optimization with perturbation bounds of ±75 nm around the previous best candidate thicknesses [283.0, 282.0, 210.0, 307.0, 273.0, 296.0, 255.0, 295.0, 314.0, 283.0, 81.0, 83.0] nm, respecting hard bounds of 20-400 nm per layer. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final optimized thicknesses_nm. Minimize joint mean reflectance across both wavelength bands. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 1260-1360 nm, 1530-1565 nm. soft objectives: low average reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band; low average reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflection in the specified bands. manufacturing constraints: maximum 12 layers; individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm; materials restricted to Ta2O5 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Halved initialization/perturbation range from ±150 nm to ±75 nm per feedback directive to force local gradient descent mode rather than broad exploration. This targets the 0.0172 remaining headroom from previous best_target_score of 0.9828.
